checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Seated machine shoulder press is recognizable, with two handles raised above/beside the shoulders and bent elbows underneath.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Approved front-plank person/style retained: blue-gray top, terracotta leggings, bun, natural proportions and restrained educational shading; gray shoes/equipment.

checks.name: pose-and-contact
checks.observation: Both hands visibly wrap their separate handles. Full arms, legs/shoes, supported back and hips/seat are coherent; feet read as planted. No obvious duplicated limb, floating grip or disconnected joint.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Handles visibly join separate pivoting levers; stack, frame, backrest, seat and base read as continuous equipment. Independent source reviewer found no material contact defect. This is visual plausibility, not engineering certification.

checks.name: decoded-alpha
checks.observation: Source/export light/dark composites and checkerboard retain clean transparent surroundings/frame openings, without distracting colored fringe or matte. Actual cropped top details show both rounded cap outlines complete.

checks.name: small-usage-and-containment
checks.observation: Viewed source/runtime 256x144 and320x180 helper panels and both-size all-eight current-container boards: complete machine and person remain recognizable and contained. Upper lever caps are not visibly cut; top breathing room is extremely tight (~0.8dp in180).

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No text, numbers, logos, arrows, scenery, phone frame, watermark or app controls observed.

limitations: Visible alpha>=128 bbox [433,4,1262,897] on1672x941 leaves ~0.8dp top clearance in180 frame. Both cap curves are complete; generous top margins are not achieved. Nonzero alpha reaches top/bottom only as faint noise; y0 maximum11, y1 maximum14, y2 maximum15.
